title: Ridge Vision Frames GT 6
alludes_to: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 1) — camera glasses
description: The Ridge Vision Frames GT 6 is a Signature-original vision frames in the smart glasses family. It tracks the working profile of Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 1) — camera glasses: 12 MP camera with open-ear audio, from $299. Introduced in 2023, it serves everyday wearers.
